allow: PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conn\) { $pids = $conn.OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach \($p in $pids\) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "PID $p \($\($proc.ProcessName\)\) — killing"; Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "Done." } else { Write-Host "Nothing listening on port 8080." })

hooks.command: cmd /c echo Hook fired at %DATE% %TIME% >> hook.log
